C9000312.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 312 (The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis.; papers: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis via elementary expansions; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/312.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PP_FOUNDATIONS.statement: For contractible globular theories, weak equivalence has the exact-boundary test; it has two-out-of-three, retract and filtered-colimit closure, and a weak equivalence lifting J_j lifts I_j.

C_PP_CUTOFF.statement: Original-stage-order interpretation constructs R_k preserving all cells through k, for every k at most the fixed cutoff q.

C_PP_HIGH.statement: Attachments I_j and J_j of index j>k preserve all cells through k, for k<q.

C_PP_SPINE.statement: The finite spine T_m(S) has height at most m+1, retains all cells through m, and S is obtained from it by source attachments of index greater than m.

C_PP_SHAPES.statement: Every reflected free nonempty globular sum F_q(S) is contractible.

C_PP_UPPER.statement: Under E(q,j) for n<j<=q, upper I-cellular weak equivalences with cellular source split and remain weak equivalences after cellular pushouts.

C_PP_TREES.statement: Under the higher-index hypotheses, all free depth-n tree diagrams are contractible; generator homotopies are promoted using only J_(n+1).

C_PP_WHISKERS.statement: Under the higher-index hypotheses, freely adjoining one independently oriented whisker at every actual n-cell of a globular sum gives a contractible model.

C_PP_GLUE.statement: Cylinder realization has the exact one-sided skeletal pushout formula, with each shared face used once.

C_PP_CYLINDERS.statement: Under the higher-index hypotheses, the constructed P_j, A_j^epsilon for j>n, and P(S) for globular sums of height <=q are cellular and contractible; the one-sided maps above n are upper cellular weak equivalences.

C_PP_OPERATIONS.statement: All generators extend in the original free order on the partial path globular set, naturally in full models, preserving both endpoints even for composite faces of arity height j and output j-1.

C_PP_SINGLE.statement: Each endpoint lifts every boundary inclusion in A_q for every target model, not just cellular targets.

C_PP_JOINT.statement: The joint endpoint lifts J_n, via a retraction of the upper-cellular inclusion of the four-vertex three-edge tree into P_(n+1).

C_PP_PATH.statement: For every q and 0<=n<q, higher-index expansions imply all of Proposition prop:partial-path, including its algebraic interpretations and both lifting properties.

C_PP_STEP.statement: The partial path construction implies E(q,n) for arbitrary cellular sources and arbitrary attaching cells.

C_PP_FIXED.statement: For each fixed q, descending induction proves E(q,n) for every 0<=n<=q.

C_PP_ALL.statement: For every coherator in the manuscript convention, elementary expansions of all cellular models at every attaching cell are weak equivalences before reflection.

C_PP_LOCAL.statement: At a fixed q, the fixed-cutoff theorem and partial-path construction hold for a contractible globular theory with a given free filler presentation that bounds arity only for generator outputs <=q; higher-output generators may have arbitrary finite globular-sum arities and only their prescribed-face equations.

C_PP_CORE.statement: Universally: a spine at m retains generating cells and both globular face maps through m and has no cells above m+1; the recursive face maps satisfy the globular identities; bijective boundary maps give unique operations on arbitrary tuple types; naturality is closed under typed composition and jointly injective tuple legs; the duplicate-generator promotion and final domain-retract equations imply the stated W-membership consequences for every category and morphism property satisfying the specified axioms.
